_comment: Fictional worked example at revision 3. Every id referenced below exists in this file. Not a template to copy wholesale: a real project starts with empty collections and only gains a record when there is something real to record.
name: Monthly report clean-up service

sources.title: Conversation with P01, operations lead at a 9-person agency
sources.scope: One person, one 35-minute call. Their own account of their own work. Not a market finding and not a commitment.
sources.recheck_trigger: Superseded if P01 changes role or the agency changes reporting tool

sources.title: Belgian official e-invoicing FAQ, general B2B questions
sources.scope: Structured B2B e-invoicing scope and start date for Belgian VAT-taxable businesses. Does not address article 44 exempt-only persons.
sources.recheck_trigger: The announced legal adjustment for non-established taxpayers; before issuing the first real invoice

facts.text: P01 rewrites the monthly client report by hand each month because the tool's export is unreadable to their clients.
facts.scope: P01's own account on 2026-11-04. One person, one agency. Their saying it is the fact; whether it is the most costly part of their month is not established.

facts.text: The Belgian structured B2B e-invoicing obligation applies to invoices created, issued or sent from 2026-01-01, including to businesses using the small-business VAT exemption regime.
facts.scope: Belgian VAT-taxable to Belgian VAT-taxable B2B. Reported by the official FAQ; applicability to this founder's actual VAT status still needs an accountant.

assumptions.text: Small agencies will pay a third party to clean up a report they currently fix themselves.
assumptions.test: Offer a paid one-off clean-up to three agencies and record who accepts, declines, or asks the price first.

assumptions.text: A clean-up takes about one hour per report once the source file is in hand.
assumptions.test: Do one unpaid clean-up end to end and time it.

decisions.text: Offer exactly one deliverable: one cleaned-up monthly report, not a reporting subscription.
decisions.reason: The only recorded evidence concerns a single recurring manual task. A subscription would rest on assumptions nothing supports yet.
decisions.reconsider_when: Two or more agencies ask for an ongoing arrangement unprompted.
